mapper.insert: insert into business_vehicle_collect_model(collect_task_id,model_id,operation,create_time) values(#{taskId},#{modelId},#{operation},sysdate()) on duplicate key update operation=values(operation)
mapper.select: select v.id modelId,v.series_name seriesName,v.model_name modelName,v.manufacturer,v.official_guide_price officialGuidePrice, v.level,v.energy_type energyType,v.instrument_screen_size_inch instrumentScreenSizeInch, v.center_screen_size_inch centerScreenSizeInch,v.center_screen_material centerScreenMaterial, v.passenger_screen_size_inch passengerScreenSizeInch,v.rear_screen_size_inch rearScreenSizeInch, v.last_crawled_time crawledAt,r.operation, case when k.id is null then false else true end knowledgeStored from business_vehicle_collect_model r join business_vehicle_model v on v.id=r.model_id left join business_knowledge k on k.source_type='REPORT' and k.source_code=concat('VEHICLE-MODEL-', v.id) where r.collect_task_id=#{taskId} order by r.id
select model_id from business_vehicle_collect_model where collect_task_id=#{taskId} order by id
select count(1) from business_vehicle_collect_model where collect_task_id=#{taskId} and model_id=#{modelId}
select count(1) from business_knowledge where source_type='REPORT' and source_code=concat('VEHICLE-MODEL-', #{modelId})
mapper.delete: delete from business_vehicle_collect_model where collect_task_id=#{taskId} and model_id in #{id}
